description: Single voltage processor that attenuates, offsets, samples, slews or follows the envelope of a signal, and generates noise when its input is unpatched

params.text: Attenuates or amplifies the input from 0 to 2 times, and modulating it makes the module work as a gate or a VCA
Adds a constant voltage to the input, -5V to +5V
Sets the speed at which the follower moves toward its target
Attenuates and inverts the RANGE input before it is added to the RANGE knob
Attenuates and inverts the OFFSET input before it is added to the OFFSET knob
Picks how the output approaches its target: LIN at a constant rate, EXP exponentially, ENV following the envelope of the input

inputs.text: A control voltage added to the RANGE setting, scaled by the RANGE attenuverter
A control voltage added to the OFFSET setting, scaled by the OFFSET attenuverter
The signal to be processed, and with nothing patched here the module generates noise instead
A rising edge here samples and holds the processed signal, and with nothing patched here the sample and hold is bypassed
